      have h₁ : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := Equiv.ofInjective f (fun a₁ a₂ h => h_inj h)
      exact h₁

      -- When α is empty, both sides are empty

        have h₃ : Set.range f = ∅ := by

          intro y hy
          obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
          exact Nonempty.elim (inferInstance : Nonempty α)
        simp [h₃]
